Coffee & drinks

What is on the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Coffee and frappé

Traditional coffee, frappé and espresso drinks. One guest calls it the best frappé in Nicosia.

Fresh lemonade

Fresh lemonade and freshly squeezed orange juice. 3 reviews mention the lemonade.

Toasts and snacks

Toasts, grilled cheese sandwiches and small snacks, with homemade sweets to go with the coffee.

Cold beer at night

In the evening it turns into a bar. 8 reviews mention the beer, and it stays open past midnight.

Colourful tables

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Laid back

Guests describe a relaxed, familiar place, good for reading a book or a long night with friends.

Music

Good music, guests write. One remembers the waiter finishing a song on his instrument before coming over.

Art on every table

Painted tables, colourful plates and walls full of drawings. Guests speak of a quirky, unique place.

Inside the walls

An alternative kafeneio and bar in old Nicosia, inside the old city walls, since 1997. Open every day until late at night.

What guests say

Three of 261 Google reviews, 200 of them with five stars.

“Very laid back cafe. When we arrived the employee there was playing an instrument. It wasn’t until the song was finished that he came to us and we realized he belonged to the cafe. That mirrors the totally relaxed and familiar atmosphere of the place. Perfect for a short stop as well as a long night.”

Google review
“A hidden cafe/bar. Good music. Very laid back atmosphere, a good place to read a book or just chill.”

Google review
“You got to be there for the atmosphere. This looks like what old Cyprus would look like. Really chill spot”
